encoding.resolveChartTap: resolveChartTap({mobile, chartType, selectedKey, tappedKey}) -> drill | select | clear (WP14 §1.4.6), the first rule that applies: tapped null (a tap outside every mark) -> clear; not mobile (a desktop click) -> drill; the Number chart (no categories) -> drill; tapped equal to selected (code units, no normalization) -> drill; otherwise select.
encoding.fields: mobile: the mobile context (web useMobileContext(), desktop DashboardBloc.state.mobileContext); chart_type: a ChartTypePB name (Bar, Line, HorizontalBar, Donut, NumberChart); selected: the category whose tooltip a previous tap shows, or null; tapped: the category key of the tapped mark (R-GROUPKEY, __empty__ for the empty category, "" for the Number card; a segment or a line point taps its category), or null.
encoding.after: What the chart does next: select keeps tapped as the selection and shows its tooltip (with the footer "Tap again to view data") until the next tap; drill opens the drill-down of the tapped mark and drops the selection; clear drops the selection and hides the tooltip.
